description:
FILED s452aa (Opus agent AA, found by the #730 sysopen probes).  PRE-EXISTING,
a NAMED member of #403's family.

    my $f = "/tmp/empty"; open(my $w, ">", $f); close($w);
    print "[", (-s $f), "] def=", (defined(-s $f) ? "y":"n"), "\n";

        perl  [0] def=y
        PCL   []  def=n

perl's `-s` on a file that EXISTS and is EMPTY returns a DEFINED 0 (the stat
succeeded and the size is zero); PCL returns undef, so `defined(-s $f)` is the
discriminator and `printf "%d"` prints nothing where perl prints 0.  #403
already states the general rule -- "a filetest's FALSE is a DEFINED value when
the stat succeeded; the whole p--* family conflates it with undef" -- and this
is the one member with a NUMERIC answer rather than "", which is why it shows
up as a missing character rather than a missing empty string.

FOUND BY: the s452aa sysopen bar (`sysopen ... O_TRUNC; print "size=", -s $f`)
disagreed with perl until the probe was rewritten to read stat()[7].  The
sysopen implementation itself was byte-identical to perl on all 12 shapes.

BAR: `-s` on an empty existing file is a defined 0; on a MISSING file it stays
undef (perl's own split); the rest of #403's family unchanged unless #403 is
taken as a whole.  Fix belongs with #403, not beside it.
--- DONE s456ah (Opus agent AH, round 13) ---
p--s now returns the stat's size unconditionally; undef means only that the
STAT FAILED.  It needed NONE of #403's ""-vs-undef machinery -- `-s` is the one
member whose answer is a VALUE rather than a flag -- which is why the numeric
member could close on its own.  0 is false to p-true-p, so no boolean use
moves.  Seven lines byte-identical to perl 5.40.3: -s empty (defined 0), -s
five-byte (5), -s missing (undef), -s _ after an explicit stat (0), printf
"%d" (0), boolean (false), and `-s -f $empty` through the `_` chain (0).
Guard: Pl/t/filetest-stack-01.t row 2 (12 -> 13 rows); its header note now says
which member of #403 is done.  #403's residue re-measured into that task: -z on
a non-empty file, -x and -d false on a successful stat.
subject: `-s` on an existing EMPTY file is undef in PCL, a DEFINED 0 in perl (#403 family, the numeric member)
